title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 125 ]

blocks.text: Since it manufactured its first car in 1955, Korea has grown to be the sixth largest automobile producer in the world. It is expected to be among the world’s top four auto-making countries by 2010 after the U.S., Japan, and Germany, in spite of its competitiveness in small car manufacturing, skilled human workforce, and leading information technology, an expected production of 6.5 million units in 2010, Korea will hold 10 percent of the global auto market.

readingSentences.english: Since it manufactured its first car in 1955, Korea has grown to be the sixth largest automobile producer in the world.
readingSentences.korean: 1955년 최초의 자동차를 생산한 이래, 한국은 세계 6위의 자동차 생산국으로 성장했다.

readingSentences.english: It is expected to be among the world’s top four auto-making countries by 2010 after the U.S., Japan, and Germany, in spite of its competitiveness in small car manufacturing, skilled human workforce, and leading information technology, an expected production of 6.5 million units in 2010, Korea will hold 10 percent of the global auto market.
readingSentences.korean: 소형차 생산 경쟁력과 숙련된 인력, 그리고 첨단 IT 기술을 바탕으로 한국은 2010년까지 미국, 일본, 독일에 이어 세계 4대 자동차 생산국에 진입할 것으로 예상되며, 2010년 650만 대 생산과 함께 세계 자동차 시장의 10%를 점유하게 될 것이다.
